news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹8.75b (US$94.7m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Systematix Corporate Services Limited Announces Resignation of Sampath Kumar Kangeyam Venkatakrishnan as Non-Executive Independent Director and as the Member of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee , Effective January 21, 2026
news.body: Systematix Corporate Services Limited announced that Mr. Sampath Kumar Kangeyam Venkatakrishnan has resigned as Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company due to pre-occupation and other personal commitments, with effect from close of business hours on January 21, 2026. Consequently, he will also be stepping down as the Member of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Systematix Corporate Services Limited Appoints Mitali Chitnis as Director & Group Chief HR Officer and Senior Management Personnel, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: Systematix Corporate Services Limited, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, has, through a circular resolution passed on January 5, 2026, approved the appointment of Ms. Mitali Chitnis as Director & Group Chief HR Officer (CHRO) and designated her as Senior Management Personnel of the Company with effect from January 5, 2026. Ms. Mitali brings with her over 19 years of rich and diverse experience in Human Resources, with deep expertise across talent management, talent acquisition, employee engagement, organizational development, total rewards and HR compliance. She has held leadership roles with reputed organizations such as Funds India, Fisdom, Motilal Oswal Financial Services, Mirae Asset Investment Managers, ASK Group, Reliance Capital, and Mahindra
